configuration.embedder: HashingEmbedder(512) (lexical feature hashing; no neural model)

systems.name: bm25
systems.description: Okapi BM25 over chunks, extractive reader returning up to 3 best sentences; always answers

systems.name: vector
systems.description: Cosine over hashing embeddings, extractive reader returning up to 3 best sentences; always answers

systems.name: hybrid_rag
systems.description: BM25 + vector with reciprocal rank fusion, extractive reader returning up to 3 best sentences; always answers

systems.name: hybrid_rag_top1
systems.description: BM25 + vector with reciprocal rank fusion, extractive reader returning only the single best sentence; always answers

systems.name: hybrid_rag_gated
systems.description: BM25 + vector with reciprocal rank fusion, extractive reader returning up to 3 best sentences; abstains when evidence covers <50% of question terms

systems.name: memoraos
systems.description: MemoraOS full pipeline: router + truth engine + fallbacks

systems.name: memoraos_hybrid_only
systems.description: MemoraOS with strategy forced to 'hybrid' (router and fact engine disabled)

external_systems.requirement: an LLM for fact extraction and an embedder (default OpenAI) or a local Ollama setup
an LLM plus a graph database server (Neo4j / FalkorDB / Kuzu)
an LLM provider and its embedded or external PostgreSQL
a Linux CUDA GPU (~80 GB for the reference demo), Python 3.11, and downloaded Qwen3 checkpoints
external_systems.notes: Apache-2.0; https://github.com/snap-stanford/memorilla; learned latent memory needs a trained module
